title: The Sun Drifts Through Cloudy Skies

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts are a place for race-ready
Umamusume to appeal to potential
trainers, which means this "Nakayama
Festa" was actually a
student here.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Oh nooo, I'm so nervous! This time,
I've gotta win... or at least,
hopefully I can
make top five!

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, new kid! So you did decide to
come check out the tryouts,
huh? Anyone
here catch your eye?

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Hmm... Nakayama Festa? Oh jeez, I
swear I've heard the name
before, but it's
escaping me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The skill and guts she displayed at the
pier were top class. With her
wits, I'm sure
she'll put on an amazing performance
today!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... Tch!

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hey, the runner you marked doesn't
seem to be doing all so
well...

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh, look. She's falling even further
behind. She doesn't look all
that tired
though, so why?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah... hahhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The way she ran was painfully bland,
earning her a thirteenth-place
finish.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I knew I shouldn't have got my hopes up. I'll have to try harder next time...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Next time," huh? Maybe that's what's
holding me back. The thought
of a second
chance.
Festa. Don't you worry about a thing.

I know you'll find what you seek at Tracen
Academy—and you'll meet
people who will
truly satisfy that burning desire in your
heart.
I promise. You'll feel alive at Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Man.
I guess it was too good to be true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The feisty spirit I saw at the pier is gone. This "Nakayama Festa" is like a different person. I mean, maybe she is. Maybe she's just a lookalike with a similar name.

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, new kid. Forget Festa.

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text: I just remembered where I heard about Nakayama Festa, and let me tell you, you do not want to take on someone that difficult yet.

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's got a reputation amongst the
instructors. They try so hard to
help, then
she blows them off. I heard she almost got
expelled for causing trouble before a
practice race.

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You saw how she just ran. Did it look like
she was giving it her best
effort? You were
just thinking that she could do better if
she applied herself, right?

text_block_list.name: Knowledgeable Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Well, she's not gonna apply herself. Okay, kid? You've just started your trainer journey. You'd both be better off picking someone else than putting in all your sweat and tears just to get burned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't even know how to respond.
He's seen a lot more runners
than I have, so I'm
sure he knows what he's talking about,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The look on Nakayama Festa's face as she
leaves the course... It's like
she's screaming
for help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but doubt whether she's
really as bad as the rumors make
her out to be. Next thing I know,
I'm looking up her track
record.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're all over the place.
Sometimes she's amazing, sometimes she's
awful. Her
average across the board isn't great, but
then again, this record only shows the
cold, hard numbers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why did she look so torn up after the
tryouts? Why didn't she just run
harder in
the race? ...I can't even begin to guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I close the set of records.
Something tells
me these numbers aren't
what I need right
now.

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Like I friggin' said, quit bumming around
here every damn day! If you
wanna know
about Nakayama, go ask her yourself!

text_block_list.name: Head Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
That's your problem! Who knows where
she is?! Damn it... Quit
followin' me
around! Don't adults have better stuff to
do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shake dirt off my clothes.
There goes yet another day of zero
progress. I haven't
learned anything meaningful about Nakayama
Festa at all.

Are you the trainer that's been going
around asking about Nakayama?
I've been
hearing rumors on and off campus.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli. But...
that's got nothing to
do with Nakayama, now
does it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
C'mere. Be a good puppy and follow my
lead—I'll give you exactly
what you've
been longing for.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This is a freestyle racecourse.
It's a casual
place for people who just
want to run
without all the rules and regulations.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Them, and the freaks who like running on
messy, unkempt grass like
this. Nakayama
used to play around here, from what I've
heard.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Were you listening? I said she used to hang here. Not anymore though—or so she says.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What, so you are back already? Since when do you keep curfew? I thought you lived for your little games.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm finally ready to run in the tryouts,
so I
cleaned up my act. That's
all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
From here out,
I'll have real races. I'll be
staking my entire future on
the big thrills...
taking mind-breaking risks with my whole
body on the
line. I don't need the small fry anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
All bark and no bite. Tch. And here I
thought she'd show me
something
entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Listen well. You wanna know Nakayama's
Achilles heel? Go visit her
old mentor at
the hospital. She'd know.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, one of my groupies used to go to
school with Nakayama before
Tracen. She
was practically begging to give me info.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, now I've got the hospital name and
contact info. What you do
with it's up to
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius thrusts a piece of paper into my
hand. I start to thank her, but
she just
turns and leaves with a little "Tch."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little worried why she has a
mentor at
a hospital, though. Her
physician, maybe?
Did she have an injury? An illness?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But then, when I arrive for our meeting, I
find the mentor in patients'
garb, resting
on a hospital bed.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, or her old elementary school teacher,
rather. She had me for
fifth grade, and
hehe... she certainly was a handful.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
There are some things you should know
about her, but before we get
into that,
there's something I'd like you to watch.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'd like to show you her strong
points
first, before we dig into the
nitty-gritty.
I've got a video from two years ago...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
The first time Festa took on the world
with
her own two feet.
